node.title: Re: Prepocessing perl code / substing variables
node.author: haukex
node.doctext: Don't try to parse Perl, [id://44722|only perl can parse Perl] (modules like [mod://PPI] come close, but still can't do everything). Use a Config:: module like [choroba] [id://1232597|suggested], or if it's only one or two simple values, environment variables can sometimes be enough (see [doc://%ENV]).
